videos.script: Lesson 3 was about what to ask an image model for. This lesson is about how to ask, in code. {{title}} Two APIs. OpenAI's Images API, which once meant DALL-E and now means its GPT image models. And Google's Gemini image model, the one people call Nano Banana. {{two}} Both take words and return a picture. Both can take a picture and change part of it. They differ in how you say which part. {{edit}} Then the question every product with generated images has to answer. What does one picture cost, and how many do you throw away to get it? {{cost}} And a warning that belongs in the code, not just the course. Several of the names in this lesson are already being retired. {{retire}} In this lab, no image model runs. The pictures that come back are cards. The calls, the errors and the prices are real. {{end}}
